# SNDK — Catalysts

## TL;DR

No catalyst within the 10-trading-day swing window as of 2026-05-06. Q4 FY2026 earnings expected ~August 13, 2026 (consensus EPS ~$31.51) — 55+ trading days out. Sell-side consensus updated: avg PT ~$1,409 per web_research/SNDK.json May 6 (high $2,000, low $1,000); stock at ~$1,410 is now essentially at the consensus average. Rating: Strong Buy (13 Buy, 3 Hold, 0 Sell). Seeking Alpha downgrade "Overheated and Primed to Fall" remains the contrarian bear signal. [source: web_research/SNDK.json analyst_consensus, run 20260506_211601]

## Upcoming events

- **Q4 FY2026 earnings:** Expected ~August 13, 2026 (range July 24–August 3 also cited); consensus EPS $31.51. ~55+ trading days out — outside swing window. [source: web_research/SNDK.json earnings_info, run 20260506_211601]
- **$6B share buyback execution:** Authorized 2026-04-30; ongoing through FY2027. Pace will be disclosed quarterly. Provides a minor price floor. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260506_211601]
- **QLC Stargate datacenter SSD ramp:** Management referenced readiness; no specific date disclosed. [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news SNDK, run 20260506_211601]
- **Kevin Warsh Fed Chair confirmation (May 15):** Hawkish succession risk — tighter-for-longer re-rates growth names with negative operating margins most sharply. [source: web_research/SNDK.json macro_context, run 20260506_211601]
- **Apple/Samsung 2026 flagship cycle:** Shift to 1TB baseline storage — NAND demand catalyst (no specific date). [source: web_research/SNDK.json key_events, run 20260506_211601]

## Recent news synthesis (last 14 days)

- **2026-05-06 — macro context:** S&P 500 hit record 7,365, Nasdaq 25,839 — semiconductor rally led by AMD +17.8%. Risk-on tailwind for SNDK name recognition but stock is already at/above consensus PT. [source: web_research/SNDK.json macro_context, run 20260506_211601]
- **2026-05-05 — Seeking Alpha downgrade:** "Overheated and Primed to Fall" — overvaluation warning after +361% YTD rally from $1,406. Still active. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260506_211601]
- **2026-05-05 — SNDK surges +13%** to new 52-week high; YTD gain ~361–422%. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260506_211601]
- **2026-05-04 — 24/7 Wall St bearish caution:** "3,314% Rally Leaves Little Room to Run" — 32% downside scenario flagged. [source: web_research/SNDK.json ticker_news, run 20260506_211601]
- **2026-04-30 — Q3 FY2026 earnings:** Revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY, +26% beat), non-GAAP EPS $23.41 (beat $14.66 est), GAAP GM 78.4%, datacenter $1.47B (+645% YoY), $42B backlog. [source: web_research/SNDK.json earnings_info, run 20260506_211601]

## Insider activity

Aggregate ~$7.3M across 20 Form 4 filings — primarily RSU tax withholdings (CEO David Goeckeler, CTO Alper Ilkbahar) plus one estate-planning gift (director Thomas Caulfield gifted 29,000 shares). No open-market conviction purchases. Sentiment: mildly negative but low-signal (typical RSU mechanics). [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news SNDK, run 20260506_211601]

## Analyst consensus

Rating: **Strong Buy** (13 Buy, 3 Hold, 0 Sell as of May 6 web_research). Post-Q3 revisions: Susquehanna $1,000→$2,000; Bernstein →$1,700 (May 4); Evercore ISI $1,200→$1,400; Citigroup →$1,300 (May 1); RBC Capital →$1,000. Avg PT ~$1,409 (web_research/SNDK.json May 6) — **stock at ~$1,410 is now essentially at the sell-side average.** The upgrade cycle from the Q3 earnings beat is largely priced. Bear outlier: Seeking Alpha "Overheated" note. [source: web_research/SNDK.json analyst_consensus, run 20260506_211601]

## Competitor context

Samsung pivoting toward HBM; SK Hynix pivoting to HBM, leaving enterprise SSD share open. Micron (MU) NAND revenues +169% YoY to $5B — shared AI demand tailwind. WDC competes in enterprise SSD for hyperscale data centers. YMTC planning 2.5x capacity expansion — longer-term supply risk. NAND pricing tight post-H2 2025 capacity cuts. [source: web_research/SNDK.json competitor_activity, run 20260506_211601]

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

| Setup Type | Trades | Wins | Win Rate | Avg P&L | Total P&L |

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
2026-05-06 | GOOG | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$6.50 | Mean-reversion short (RSI-7 90.69, Z-score 2.56) stopped at $389.50 as ADX 74.23 extreme trend absorbed the fade; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime repeated the NVDA/AMZN pattern — ADX 60+ environments make fading overbought conditions highly unreliable; strongly risk-on macro (S&P ATH, US-Iran MOU) added upside momentum.
2026-05-06 | AMD | statistical exhaustion short | OUTCOME: -$17.82 | Mean-reversion short (Z-score 2.6, RSI 83, +74% 21d surge) gap-stopped at $372.31 when Q1 2026 earnings blowout (+38% YoY, EPS +43%) gapped AMD +15% overnight; swing_mean_reversion and swing_catalyst_news recommended the fade but earnings binary created a non-linear gap-through-stop outcome; half-sizing to 1 share limited damage to -$17.82 vs -$35.64.
